product_metadata.title: Naler Ornament Hooks Stainless Steel S-Shaped Hangers for Christmas Ornaments Decorations, 120 Pack
features: [ VALUE PACK ] Approx. 120 hooks for hanging ornaments.
[ SIZE ] The ornament hooks are measured at 1.2” x 0.5”(L*W).
[ MATERIAL ] The ornament hangers are made of durable stainless steel, reusable and won’t rust easily.
[ DESIGN ] Ornament hooks are in S shape so that it’s convenient for hanging ornaments on anywhere you want, also providing a more pretty look on your decoration.

[ VERSATILITY ] Ideal for hanging Christmas ornaments or other small items, also suitable for using in wedding party, bridal shower, baby shower, bachelorette party, birthday party, home decorations and daily use.
